issues.problem: The home page supports 'over 35 years' in business and separately gives the current address (33 Jackson St, South River, NJ 08882), but no source states the business has been at that address for 35 years. As written the line asserts tenure at the address, which is unsupported (not found in any page opened).
issues.fix: Reword to what is sourced: "Thirty-five-plus years in business, based at 33 Jackson St" (or "35+ years, at 33 Jackson St in South River").

issues.claim: "requests outside 9-6 weekdays have no route in" (Section 1, Impact)
issues.problem: Contradicted by the business's own site: the public Gmail address (YuhasPlumbers@gmail.com) and both phone lines still accept messages outside those hours. What is true is that nothing answers or triages them until the next business day. As written it overstates the gap and inflates the problem.
issues.fix: Change to: "nothing answers outside 9-6 weekdays - calls go to voicemail and emails sit in a Gmail inbox until the next business day."

issues.claim: Sources line: Birdeye URL as the source for "hours Mon-Fri 9:00-6:00, closed weekends"
issues.problem: https://reviews.birdeye.com/yuhas-plumbing-heating-166609342213442 returned HTTP 404 on two attempts during verification (the page body is still visible in a search index and confirms the same hours, and Nextdoor shows identical hours, so the fact itself stands). A dead citation should not go out.
issues.fix: Cite the Nextdoor page (opened and shows Mon-Fri 9:00 AM-6:00 PM, closed Sat/Sun) for hours, or re-check the Birdeye URL before sending.

issues.claim: "anyone tapping a broken button reaches a dead or wrong number" (Section 1, Impact)
issues.problem: Stated as fact; it is a consequence-based inference (the 9-digit tel: link cannot dial, the transposed number is not the listed line). Elsewhere the audit labels its assumptions, so this reads inconsistently.
issues.fix: Frame as inference: "anyone tapping a broken button most likely reaches a dead or wrong number".

issues.claim: Email draft: "two of the three 'Call Yuhas Plumbing' buttons dial wrong numbers"
issues.problem: The three tappable CTAs are labelled "Call Now! (732) 257-7013" (header, correct), "Call Yuhas Plumbing" (tel:732577013, 9 digits) and "Call Yuhas Plumbing Today!" (tel:7323577013, transposed). The count and the defect are right, but quoting all three as "Call Yuhas Plumbing" buttons is loose.
issues.fix: Use "two of the three call buttons" in the email and opener, or name the two labels exactly.

issues.problem: Not inflated - the arithmetic checks out ($47.02/h x 78-234 h) - but it is higher than the analyst's own range in analysis.json ($3,000-$9,000) because of the x1.25 benefits load and 100% automation share. Both loads are labelled "our assumption", so this is a consistency note, not an error.
issues.fix: Optionally add one clause noting the benefits load is the reason the range sits above the unloaded estimate, or align the two documents.
